title: Eccentricity and Shape Variation
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Describe the geometric shape of an ellipse as its eccentricity e approaches 0.
finalAnswer: \text{As } e \to 0, \text{ the foci coalesce at the center and the ellipse becomes a circle}

steps.title: Relate Eccentricity to Semi-Axes
steps.explanation: Expression of eccentricity in terms of axis ratio b/a.

steps.title: Take Limit as e -> 0
steps.explanation: When semi-minor axis b approaches semi-major axis a, the ellipse becomes a circle.
